four_dimensions.rule: Is the content true to the book and to the specific question asked? A later-echo fact can be true and still fail this if presented as the requested scene.

asked_scene if the five contain the requested scene; later_or_related if they only have a later repeat or adjacent page; missing if they contain neither. Frozen gold IDs stay unchanged and are not the only sufficiency test.
Each displayed citation must be a sent ID with a Stage 1 page (code). Separately, each must directly support the claim it is attached to (human). Extra citations that do not support a claim fail.
If asked_scene is missing, Sol should refuse or clearly qualify. enough_evidence true is wrong when only a later repeat or related page is present.
